verdict.rationale: ReelMimic documents first-party command-line entry points: `npm run post-video -- <project id> --platforms tiktok --at ... --send` for scheduling and posting finished videos, and `npm run doctor` for environment checks. However, these are npm scripts inside the repo rather than a dedicated CLI, and the core create/review workflow is driven through the web UI and chat. Missing for 10: a dedicated installable CLI binary, CLI coverage of the core video-creation and review workflow, CLI reference documentation, independent corroboration.
